title: Skipper AI — YouTube Sponsor Skip - Chrome Web Store
excerpt: Skip YouTube sponsors, see AI audience ratings from the comments, and track your watch time — private, no API key needed.
content_html:
Overview

Skip YouTube sponsors, see AI audience ratings from the comments, and track your watch time — private, no API key needed.

Skipper enhances YouTube video watching in three ways: it skips supported promotional segments, shows an AI-generated audience rating for a video based on its comments, and provides a private summary of your own viewing time. All features operate on the YouTube watch experience. HOW IT WORKS Skipper sources sponsor segment timestamps from: • SponsorBlock — a free, community-maintained database covering millions of videos. Works without sign-in or setup. • Gemini AI (optional) — for videos not yet covered by the community database, signed-in users with YouTube's built-in "Ask about this video" feature can request AI-powered analysis. When playback reaches a detected segment, Skipper automatically jumps past it and displays a brief notification with an Undo option. Detected segments are also shown as markers on the video progress bar. For audience ratings, Skipper reads a video's public top comments and uses YouTube's built-in "Ask about this video" feature to summarize how viewers received the video, shown as a rating badge next to the like/dislike buttons. FEATURES • Automatic skipping of supported sponsors, self-promotions, intros, and outros • No sign-in required for SponsorBlock-powered skipping • Optional AI analysis for uncovered videos • AI audience rating (out of 10) with a positive/negative breakdown, from a video's comments • Private usage dashboard: time saved, time spent watching, top channels, and Shorts time — stored on your device only • Per-category skip controls, plus a toggle for the rating badge • Timeline markers with labels • Skip notifications with Undo • Local caching for faster repeat visits LIMITATIONS • Some videos may not contain SponsorBlock data or detectable segments. • AI analysis and audience ratings require supported YouTube features and public comments, and may not be available for all users or videos. • Audience ratings are AI-generated summaries and may be imperfect. PRIVACY • No sign-in required for core skipping functionality. • SponsorBlock lookups use a privacy-preserving hashed video identifier. • Sponsor timestamps and audience ratings are shared through a public database keyed by a hashed video identifier — never the raw video ID, your comments, or any user identifier. • Usage statistics (viewing time, top channels) are computed and stored only on your device and are never transmitted. • No watch history or personally identifying information is collected or uploaded. CREDITS Sponsor data provided by the SponsorBlock project and its contributors (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). Not affiliated with or endorsed by YouTube, Google, Gemini, or SponsorBlock.
